definitions: An offer to carry out work, supply goods, or buy land, shares, or another asset at a stated price.
A boat used to ferry people or goods to or from a ship.
A person who looks after someone or something.
A railway vehicle that carries fuel and water for the locomotive.
examples: The company won the tender for the construction project.
The cruise ship's tender brought passengers ashore.
He worked as a bar tender for many years.
The locomotive's tender was full of coal.
